about: Haggis schedule inputs. Each tick count and rate carries evidence (MEASURED / CODE-READ / ESTIMATE) and a source. Edit numbers here; no code change is needed. Rates: floor = best case (higher rate). suppliesLadder = supplies computed from the tier tables in haggis.ts. `serves` lists the boards that need the activity; XP to other skills still counts but does not pull the activity earlier. Level and QP requirements also need an activity in `requires`, so the deadline pulls the unlock forward. Travel: `at` is the activity's place (a key of `places`, 'anywhere' for inventory work or trades, 'bank' for the nearest bank), `endAt` where it ends, `via` places it visits in order, `bankTrips` round trips to the nearest bank; legs come from haggis-travel.json (bun packages/planner/src/travel-gen.ts). `out` marks a row that relies on a content bug, or on an item with no legal source at this scale: it is never scheduled. `unsourceable` lists those items; no active row may need more than `max` of one (haggis.test.ts). `leadTime` on a row is the helper staging work for its supplies (ESTIMATE unless it says otherwise).
